matches.rationale: Finding 1 identifies that the formulation W₀x + ΔWx cannot represent the attention-based cross-modal updates, which directly addresses the mathematical invalidity of Equation (3)'s decomposition into unimodal and cross-modal parts as a fixed matrix multiplication.

Finding 2 explicitly identifies the attention scaling issue, noting that the paper uses sqrt(d) in the main text but should use the rank-r dimension, and mentions Appendix B uses sqrt(N_t). This directly detects the ground truth defect about misusing N_t as the scaling divisor instead of feature dimensionality.
Neither finding addresses the specific inconsistency in Equation (13) regarding the omission of matrix B applied to the zero vector for text tokens in the cross-modal adaptation term.

Detects gt_id 2's attention scaling dimension error.
